assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: single landscape editorial photograph for a premium Indonesian wellness website program journey card, 4:3 aspect ratio. One coherent photo, no collage. Style: natural realistic Indonesian people, subtle skin texture, warm welcoming daylight, same clean ivory clinic environment with light oak, soft beige, a little muted sage/teal, small plant in background. Warm-neutral white balance, polished but candid premium editorial photography, eye-level medium shot, subjects comfortably framed with some breathing room, suitable for responsive card crop. No needles, no infusion, no blood, no futuristic device, no glowing anatomy, no claims of cure. Not oversaturated or airbrushed.

Warm professional smiles and natural hand gesture, authentic consultation, patient in three-quarter view, tablet lying on table with screen not legible. Both people are visible, not cropped at head. Clean clinic shelving in soft background blur.
